blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — A police officer assigned in Lanao del Sur was shot dead by two unidentified gunmen inside a boarding house in Kidapawan City, North Cotabato on Monday, police said. Col. Ramel Hojilla, provincial director of the Cotabato Provincial Police Office (CPPO), identified the victim as Capt. Razul Guiambangan Pandulo, assigned at the Bubong Municipal Police Station in Lanao del Sur under the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR).
